steps.message: Move the file first_day_school.jpg from Movies within the sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area to the DCIM within the same sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area in the Android filesystem.

Execute: adb shell "set -e; SRC=''; for p in /storage/emulated/0/Movies/first_day_school.jpg /sdcard/Movies/first_day_school.jpg /storage/self/primary/Movies/first_day_school.jpg; do if [ -f \"$p\" ]; then SRC=\"$p\"; break; fi; done; [ -n \"$SRC\" ]; ROOT=$(dirname \"$(dirname \"$SRC\")\"); mkdir -p \"$ROOT/DCIM\"; mv \"$SRC\" \"$ROOT/DCIM/first_day_school.jpg\"; ls -l \"$ROOT/DCIM/first_day_school.jpg\""

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "set -e; SRC=''; for p in /storage/emulated/0/Movies/first_day_school.jpg /sdcard/Movies/first_day_school.jpg /storage/self/primary/Movies/first_day_school.jpg; do if [ -f \"$p\" ]; then SRC=\"$p\"; break; fi; done; [ -n \"$SRC\" ]; ROOT=$(dirname \"$(dirname \"$SRC\")\"); mkdir -p \"$ROOT/DCIM\"; mv \"$SRC\" \"$ROOT/DCIM/first_day_school.jpg\"; ls -l \"$ROOT/DCIM/first_day_school.jpg\"""

extra.finish_description: Moved first_day_school.jpg from Movies to DCIM in the same sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area.
